literal.description: Re-read one turn of a recorded conversation. Every agent's sessions are listed in the memory index under sessions/ (each document names its conversation id), and the 'where we left off' block at session start shows each turn as one line labeled with its number in square brackets, e.g. [7]. Pass the conversation id and a turn number. The default view, light, shows the user prompts and the agent's replies verbatim and each tool call as one line: its tool, the head of its arguments, the head and tail of its result, the result's size and the call that opens it; it stops at 64 KiB and names the record the turn goes on from. view=prompts shows the user prompts only; view=calls adds every call with its arguments whole and each result as its size; view=full shows the whole turn, a result over 4 KiB as its head and tail. call=<id> opens that call's result and seq=<n> opens the piece holding record n (a search hit or a marker names it) from its beginning: each answers one part of at most 64 KiB, and when more follows a marker names the part=<n> that continues it. Reasoning, attachments and other opaque data are never shown. Use it whenever a log line mentions something you need the details of, and to read the URL, path or id a [link <id>:N] handle stands for.

turn.description: The turn number shown in square brackets in the session's log, e.g. 7 for [7].

conversation.description: The conversation id, as the sessions/ document or the view names it.

call.description: The id of one tool call of that turn, as a light line or a marker names it: opens that call's result, one part of at most 64 KiB at a time.

view.description: light (the default when omitted): prompts and replies verbatim, one line per tool call; prompts: the user prompts only; calls: also every call's arguments whole and each result's size; full: the whole turn, a long result as its head and tail.

seq.description: A record of that turn, as a search hit or a marker names it: opens the piece holding it from its beginning, one part of at most 64 KiB at a time.

part.description: Which part of the piece that call or seq opens, counted from 0 (the default); each part's marker names the next.

literal.description: Continue a recorded conversation: the one call to make when the user says to continue, carry on, pick up or resume where another session (any agent) left off. Delivers that conversation within a budget, in the default view (light): every user prompt and final answer verbatim, tool rounds as one line each, the older turns as one-line log entries; its handoff note first when one is pending, which this call picks up. view=prompts shows the user prompts only; view=calls shows every tool call with its arguments and each result by its size; view=full adds each result's head and tail and its size, and stays within 32,768 characters. Omit conversation to continue the session the pending note names, else the most recent session listed in the memory index under sessions/; pass conversation=<id> to continue that one. Afterwards carry on as the same work. Never call it for new work: a session that continues nothing is a new session.

conversation.description: The conversation id to continue, as the sessions/ document or the handoff note names it; omit for the pending note's session, else the most recent one listed.

session.description: Your exact current session ID from the session hook, for immediate continuation routing.

view.description: light (the default when omitted): prompts and final answers verbatim, tool rounds one line each; prompts: the user prompts only; calls: also every tool call's arguments and each result's size; full: also each result's head and tail and its size, within 32,768 characters.

literal.description: Search every recorded conversation by its words (case-insensitive substrings, separated by spaces). Results rank best match first by default: one term suffices and rarer terms count more, so add synonyms to one query; order=newest needs every term, newest first. since and before limit turn time (UTC, ending in Z); before is an exact as-of cutoff. With records a hit names one record, e.g. [cc-7f3a #42.9 tool_result Bash] (turn 42, record 9), with an excerpt: pass conversation, turn and seq to recall_turn to open it, or view="full" for the turn. Otherwise a hit names a turn, e.g. [cc-7f3a #2], for recall_turn. kinds (prompt, reply, tool_call, tool_result, system) searches only those records, not messages; without records it filters the turns found, saying so. Use it when the memory index and the 'where we left off' block do not say where something happened. conversation=<id> searches one session; limit caps hits (default 10, at most 50). A later turn can supersede an earlier one, so check newer hits first.

query.description: One or more terms separated by spaces, case-insensitively; relevance needs one, newest every one.

conversation.description: The id of one conversation to search, as the sessions/ document names it; omit for every recorded conversation.

limit.description: How many hits to return (default 10, at most 50).

order.description: relevance (the default when omitted): best match first; newest: every term, newest first.

since.description: Only turns at or after this UTC instant, RFC 3339 ending in Z.

before.description: Only turns before this UTC instant, RFC 3339 ending in Z: an exact as-of cutoff.

kinds.description: Only these kinds of record: prompt, reply, tool_call, tool_result, system (default all five). Reasoning, attachments and other opaque data are never searched, and mailbox messages are left out.
